content.title: ‘Masked Singer’ Season 14 Finale Live Updates: Winner Revealed
content.text: The Masked Singer season 14 finale is here—and after weeks of wild clues, over-the-top performances and plenty of wrong guesses from the panel, it all comes down to this. Four finalists—Galaxy Girl, Cat Witch, Crane and Pugcasso—will take the stage one last time as they compete for the Golden Mask trophy. Tonight’s two-hour finale promises big performances, final clue packages and, of course, the long-awaited unmaskings that will reveal who has been behind the costumes all along. Related: ‘Masked Singer’ Winner Reveals What It Was Like Competing Against Her Husband (Exclusive) We’ll be updating this post live throughout the episode with every performance, clue and reveal, so check back throughout the night as it all unfolds. Before the performances and unmaskings, vote below in our poll for who you think should win season 14. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 10:25 PM EDT)What a Fun SeasonThanks for following along here at Parade with all of our Masked Singer coverage. If you’re interested, here is our finale interview with Ashlee Simpson where she talks about how weird it was to compete against her husband. And here is our finale interview with Phillip Phillips, who joked that he tried to get eliminated early so he could go home to his family sooner. Hopefully, the show comes back later this year for season 15. We aren’t sure if they’ll go back to two per year, but we do feel fairly confident that the show will be renewed later this spring at the FOX Upfronts. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 10:13 PM EDT)Galaxy Girl is Unmasked As…14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 10:05 PM EDT)2nd Place Finisher Pugcasso is Revealed As…Jenny is right! It’s American Idol season 11 winner Phillip Phillips, whose coronation song “Home” was the biggest coronation song hit in Idol history, reaching No. 6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 1 on the Adult Alternative, Adult Contemporary and Adult Pop charts.14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 10:04 PM EDT)‘It’s Always a “Yes” From Me, Dawg’Before Galaxy Girl’s unmasking, Pugcasso’s final clue was delivered via video from American Idol judge Randy Jackson, who said, “It’s always been a ‘yes’ from me, dawg,” and the final clue was a golden ticket. The panel is gobsmacked because they hadn’t really guessed anyone from American Idol so far. After those clues, Robin said based on American Idol lore and the Hawaiian shirt, it’s Justin Guarini, runner-up from Idol season 1. Ken guessed Bo Bice, runner-up from Idol season 4. Rita guesses that it was Kris Allen, the winner of season 8. But Jenny had it dialed in—there was a clue about Jenny introducing this person and she said there’s one person she introduced on The View who was also on American Idol and that person is… Phillip Phillips. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 10:01 PM EDT)Now it’s time to find out the 2nd place finisher and the winner. And the winner is… Galaxy Girl, leaving Pugcasso as the runner-up! Only about 12% of our poll responders so far thought Galaxy Girl would win.14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 9:48 PM EDT)3rd Place Goes To…Time for vote No. 2. The singer in 3rd place is… Cat Witch. Based on our poll below, fans thought she was the favorite to win! The final clue was introduced via video by Meg Donnelly, who finished in 3rd place last season as Coral. The two have worked together in Descendants/Zombies Worlds Collide: Concert Special and High School Musical: The Musical: The Series. The final clue was a mousetrap with some cheese on it. The panel locked in their final guesses: Ken said Ashley Tisdale, Robin guessed Victoria Justice, Rita said it’s Kylie Cantrall and Jenny agreed with Rita. And then Cat Witch was revealed to be Kylie, which we at home knew all along. Rita was screaming in excitement Kylie then got to show the panel her journey of being America’s Insider before Rita came up on stage to hug her and she sung herself off with her own song, “Denim.” 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 9:40 PM EDT)Pugcasso Has Ken Jeong’s HeartPugcasso’s final performance was “Sussudio” by Phil Collins and this might be my favorite Pugcasso performance yet, super high energy and a lot of fun. “Talk about song choice! You sang my favorite song of all, ‘Fake Plastic Trees’ by Radiohead, and then you cap it off with ‘Sussudio’ by Phil Collins, are you kidding me?!” gushed Ken.14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 9:35 PM EDT)A Trip Down Memory LaneThe panel then took a minute to revisit their favorite moments from the season. Ken said this was his favorite season of the show so far—but doesn’t he say that every yar? Jenny said Tiffany Haddish’s unmasking was the funniest thing ever (no arguments here, that was hilarious) and Robin said he really loved having Kelly Osbourne there for the Ozzy Osbourne tribute night.14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 9:33 PM EDT)Cat Witch is on Fire TonightCat Witch then took the stage to perform “Greedy” by Tate McRae. “This is about your essence and you truly captured it tonight, great job,” said Ken. And then Cat Witch talked without the voice filter and Rita instantly recognized who it was, you could see it on her face (though she kind of already knew).14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 9:23 PM EDT)Galaxy Girl Makes Her Case to WinAfter Normani’s sing-off, each costume is going to perform again. Galaxy Girl kicked things off with a performance of “Try” by P!NK. “You have this amazing ability and talent to capture the audience and your voice! So powerful, so amazing,” raved Jenny afterward. The next Galaxy Girl clue is that they remove the voice filter, which probably only helps if you’re already fairly sure who it is. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 9:09 PM EDT)Don’t Worry, ‘The Masked Singer’ is Coming Back SoonThe finale of The Masked Singer will resume after the presidential address.14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 8:49 PM EDT)4th Place Goes To…Time for the first vote. Crane was eliminated, finishing in 4th place. Before the final guesses, her final case was revealed by none other than Crane’s BFF, Khalid. The final clue was a plaque of awards: AMA, Guinness World Record, VMA and Kids Choice Award. The panel locked in their final guesses: Ken guessed Kelly Rowland, while Rita, Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg and Robin Thicke guessed Normani of the girl group Fifth Harmony. And Crane is revealed to be… Normani! 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 8:39 PM EDT)Crane Doesn’t Soar Quite as HighThe final performance before someone was eliminated is from Crane, who talked about how being on The Masked Singer was so “healing” because she’s been lonely without her former performing group that recently reunited. She then performed “Together Again” by Janet Jackson and it was not my favorite Crane performance of the season, but obviously it was still very good because she’s a great singer. But this was a little boring for me. The judges revisited Mya, Ashanti, Ciara, Taylor Swift (snort laugh, it is not T-Swizzle), SZA, Normani and Halle Bailey. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 8:29 PM EDT)Pugcasso Shows Off His ‘True Colors’Pugcasso was third, revisiting some clues that included “Home Plate,” “Bye Bye Bye” and a matchbox. He performed a stripped-down version of “True Colors” by Cyndi Lauper and it was beautiful. “You’re an amazing storyteller, it has been a joy to watch you flourish on their show,” said Rita. Some of the previous guesses were Ryan Tedder, Jack Johnson, Vance Joy, Gavin DeGraw, Dan Reynolds, Rob Thomas and Pat Monahan. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 8:18 PM EDT)Cat Witch Crushes Some JoJoCat Witch was up next. Some of her final clues included a pocket watch, a megaphone that reads “Victory” on it and the phrase “Hello, cutie,” all of which are nods to her Disney Channel background (because we know Cat Witch is Kylie Cantrall). Cat Witch’s performance was “Leave (Get Out)” by JoJo and she brought the house down, just like always. Everybody left is really talented. The judges also said this was Cat Witch’s best performance so far, which—they’re going to say that for everyone, but in this case, that was definitely her best performance of the season. The guesses this season included Addison Rae, Victoria Justice, Ashley Tisdale, Jamie Lynn Spears, Noah Cyrus and Charli D’Amelio, plus all the ladies from Katseye. Rita Ora also thought it could be Kylie Cantrall. Won’t she be delighted?! 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 8:09 PM EDT)This Was One of Galaxy Girl’s Best PerformancesUp first performing was Galaxy Girl, whose final clues included talking about her public humiliation where she was called a “fraud” and a “fake.” But being on The Masked Singer has let her put that all behind her; she’s doing this for her kids. She performed “Good 4 U” by Olivia Rodrigo and did an incredible job—though everybody left in the competition can definitely sing very, very well. The judges said this was Galaxy Girl’s best performance so far (I might have to agree) and revisited some of their past guesses: Taylor Momsen, Jennifer Love Hewitt, Hilary Duff, Ashlee Simpson, and Dixie D’Amelio. 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 8:07 PM EDT)Famous Friends IncomingBefore the performances start, host Nick Cannon informed the audience and viewers that between these four remaining celebrities, they have sold nearly 30 million albums worldwide and those albums include nine certified Gold and 10 certified Platinum singles. Nick then revealed that for the first time in Masked Singer history, the four finalists’ final clue will be revealed by someone in their life who is also famous! Ooooh! 14 days ago (Apr 1, 2026 5:19 PM EDT)Oh, Ken…stick to comedy, sirAfter an opening number of “Mystical Magical” by Benson Boone performed by all four finalists plus panelist Ken Jeong, the finale got right to it. Follow along with our live blog for all the unmaskings as they happen in real time, but be warned of spoilers. Don’t keep reading if you don’t want to be spoiled. Related: ‘Masked Singer’ Runner-Up Jokes He Tried to Get Eliminated Early (Exclusive) Who should be 'The Masked Singer' season 14 winner?Galaxy GirlGalaxy Girl14% This wraps things up for The Masked Singer season 14. There is no word yet as to whether the show will return for a 15th season and/or if it will go back to airing two seasons per calendar year. Stay tuned for the FOX Upfronts on Monday, May 11. That is typically when the network will announce the renewal. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 About the authorAndrea Reiher is an entertainment journalist specializing in television and music coverage. With nearly 20 years of experience, she is an authority on everything from reality TV to prestige dramas, from classic rock to Taylor Swift.
